status: Implementation brief; numbers are first-pass tuning, not playtested
title: First Call: The Basement From Hell
baseline: Prototype 26: 2400 pixels, 4 platforms, 3 Flushfiends; no boss
scope: Expand the existing corporate basement into a complete side-scrolling mission; preserve approved opening and completion dialogue.

duration.measurement: First successful run excluding dialogue, pause and deaths; aspiration pending telemetry
duration.note: Do not inflate duration with empty corridors, inflated HP or forced waiting. Record actual clear time for both heroes.

movement_contract.rule: Validate with slower Sean including acceleration and early release. No lethal pits. Upper paths are optional; grounded objects may require a single reachable jump.
movement_contract.collision: Grounded machinery and pipe bundles have solid sides and tops matching their silhouette. Suspended service grates may be one-way. Do not draw a solid object with walk-through collision.

encounter_contract.activation: Prefer visible forward spawns with at least 220 pixels of separation. At a closed encounter gate, a queued reinforcement may arrive to either side only through the telegraphed reinforcement rule. Count telegraphing plus active enemies against the cap of four.
encounter_contract.pursuit: Retain approved persistent pursuit after aggro; never silently leash or delete survivors. Delay later waves if earlier pursuers fill the active cap.
encounter_contract.completion: A clear objective must account for all 30 authored enemies, including queued enemies. No exit softlock from unspawned enemies. Finale only begins once earlier encounters are resolved.
encounter_contract.routing: Enemies cannot pass through solid props. Ground enemies must negotiate low obstacles or have connected alternate routes; test pursuit at every prop.
encounter_contract.fairness: No unannounced behind-player spawns, checkpoint spawns, landing-zone spawns or spawns during dialogue. A visible rear reinforcement is permitted only with the warning, clearance and cancellation rules below.

gates.decision: Approve visible finite encounter gates, with a necessary explicit exception for safely telegraphed rear reinforcements. A gate alone does not guarantee room ahead of a player pressed against it.
gates.placement: One gate at the exit of each authored zone, including the final exit. Engineering chooses coordinates after carving out a clear combat pocket; preserve checkpoint footprints on the far side.
gates.appearance: Art supplies a reusable industrial service shutter with closed/open states. Closed silhouette must span the traversable height and match collision; no invisible walls or code-drawn substitutes.
gates.behavior: Starts visibly closed before entry; never drops onto player or enemy. Opens immediately when the zone finite queue and surviving enemies are cleared; remains open across deaths. No timer padding. Backtracking remains open.
gates.reinforcements: Prefer ahead of the hero. If no forward location exists, choose a fully visible clear floor location behind with at least 220 pixels from player collision bounds, outside checkpoint footprints and predicted jump landing. Show the existing enemy sprite as a non-colliding flashing warning for at least 1.25 seconds before activation; this reuses art, not a substitute drawing. No damage or attacks during warning.
gates.recheck: Before activation recheck separation, visible camera bounds, prop/enemy overlap and landing safety. If unsafe, cancel and requeue without consuming a kill or spawn count. Do not pause the whole game; a queued enemy never counts as defeated.
gates.liveness: Reserve at least a 640-pixel continuous clear combat lane before each gate, with two candidate reinforcement locations. Test rushing gate, leftmost/rightmost player positions, camping candidate locations, repeated jumping, retreat and checkpoint retry. If no safe candidate exists, reposition terrain or gate; do not reduce warning distance or violate cap.
gates.ui: Show finite zone enemies remaining including queued enemies using existing HUD text; a closed gate must communicate why it is closed.
gates.art_dependency: Engineering supplies exact source dimensions and anchor/collider contract to Bestiary / Art before generation.

zones.purpose: Immediate action and a readable first object jump, no tutorial overlay
zones.art: Low pipe bundles and broken pump plinth; open sightlines

zones.purpose: Alternating low and high routes through stored equipment
zones.art: Pipe storage, heavy pump housings and supported service shelf

zones.purpose: Recovery pocket followed by two short combat groups; reserve hazards for validated art and mechanics
zones.art: Pressure manifolds; any active leak requires visible warning and safe approach

zones.purpose: Broad machinery staircase, optional upper firing position, then open recovery space
zones.art: Connected collapsed pump assembly with grounded supports; no floating slab staircase

zones.purpose: Final remix of small groups, cover and open lanes; checkpoint before finale
zones.art: Heavy return pipes, foreground rubble outside combat silhouettes

zones.purpose: Complete the job in an open finale arena
zones.art: Distinct sump chamber; leave at least 640 pixels of connected clear combat floor
zones.finale: First integration uses two finite Flushfiend waves (3 then 2). The Clogfather replaces this fallback only when boss mechanics, art and timing are validated; never present fallback as boss delivery.

terrain_coordinates: Each tuple is x, top_y, width, height in logical pixels; these are intended solid object bounds. All bases reach floor_y=440. Engineering may use a narrower verified art-aligned collider, preserving reachable top surfaces.
spawn_adjustment: Authored enemy_x values express encounter intent. Do not use nearest-clear-point relocation as final placement: it clusters homes and reverses intended order. Engineering must reserve broad combat pockets, relocate terrain and distribute staged homes in route order, outside props and checkpoint footprints.

recovery.activation: Restore to selected hero max health once at each newly reached checkpoint; show plumber tape using existing art.
recovery.death: Restore health and return to latest checkpoint; cleared enemies remain cleared, queued waves persist. Preserve pursuit identity but ensure a safe respawn position and grace before contact.
recovery.restart: Reset all enemies, waves, checkpoints and mission progress. Preserve selected hero and existing story replay rules.

art_contract.background: Reuse existing basement pending new art; request entry/storage, pressure/pump and sump variants, built for 960x540 viewport and seamless scrolling.
art_contract.foreground: Transparent PNG props with explicit foot anchors, top-surface coordinates and collision bounds. Decorative debris must not hide enemies, projectiles or landing edges.
art_contract.priority: Grounded low pipe bundle, medium pump housing, tall supported assembly, then zone backgrounds and non-colliding foreground debris.
art_contract.restriction: No independently generated or code-drawn substitute scenery. Existing art may be reused with its actual collision semantics; missing pieces remain explicitly pending.

deferred: Hallowed Widow and other species until playable AI and animations validate
Clogfather boss subject to existing combat-design.json, starter range and timing validation
Acid drips until telegraph art, safe-lane logic and contact-hit damage scale are validated
Portal and destination until Storyboarding resolves story direction
Alternative camera/perspective levels: future design exploration, no conversion of this first mission
acceptance: Both Tony and Sean can traverse every mandatory jump and finish all authored encounters
All 30 enemies are accounted for; at most four active attackers; no spawn or patrol inside a prop
Checkpoints do not activate repeatedly; death, restart and finale wave transitions cannot softlock
Persistent pursuers negotiate props; projectiles use the same solid-world bounds as movement
Camera, floor, background tiling, exit and HUD cover all 9600 pixels without old 2400 limits
Record clear time and damage per zone for both heroes; do not claim target duration as measured
Preserve prior build and capture actual running-game screenshots under the project permission rule
Roadmap and storybook distinguish integrated fallback, pending art and planned boss
Gate liveness and warning-spawn safety pass for both heroes, including rushing and camping; gates never conceal unresolvable queued enemies.

coordination.alignment: Corporate-HQ service infrastructure and sump finale match Storyboarding. Existing ending applies only to cleared ordinary enemies; boss and portal need a dedicated approved replacement ending.
coordination.delivery_boundary: Expanded playable route is an intermediate delivery toward the complete first mission. Do not mark the intended Clogfather mission complete with a Flushfiend fallback.
coordination.engineering_budget: Engineering suggested 18–24 enemies over 6000–8000 pixels. Level Design proposes 30 over 9600 with a four-attacker cap; reduce empty distance or repetitive encounters after measured playtests, not by increasing HP.
coordination.story_review: Storyboarding reviewed the six-zone route: no narrative conflicts. All authored enemies must be defeated for current completion text; fallback must not imply boss defeat, repaired plumbing or headquarters safety.
